header:
Sets UI_ScreenFlags bit 4 (repaint in place, through sub_F46015) when UI_ScreenId is one of the six screens that show the song position: 0x06 REALTIME RECORD, 0x08 CYCLE RECORD, 0x12 SEQ PLAY, 0x14 CYCLE PLAY and the cycle-play screens 0x26 / 0x29 of NOTE / DRUM EDIT.
Run after the position moves: Seq_LocateToSongPosition, Seq_ResetPositionToSongStart and the count-in bar code sub_F44CEA. Basis: callers + body + screen-id table.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93968 `calr sub_F45FE5` -- Seq_LocateToSongPosition, right after storing the located position (and only on screen 0x12, 93966)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94605 `calr sub_F45FE5` -- Seq_ResetPositionToSongStart
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97638 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenId, 0x26` -- body: the screen-id list 0x26, 0x29, 0x12, 0x14, 0x06, 0x08 (97638-97648)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97648 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenId, 0x08` -- last id of the list; any other screen skips the call
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97652 `calr sub_F46015` -- on a listed screen
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97668 `m_or_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenFlags, 0x10` -- sub_F46015: UI_ScreenFlags |= 0x10, bit 4 = repaint in place (wsa1_ram.inc)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:62454 `.long ScreenFieldList_RealtimeRecordScreen` -- screen 6 = REALTIME RECORD; [8] CycleRecordScreen 62456, [18] SeqPlayScreen 62466, [20] CyclePlayScreen 62468
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:62489 `.long ScreenFieldList_CyclePlayEditScreen29` -- screen 0x29 = the cycle-play edit screen

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:123782 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenId, 0x26` -- CyclePlayEdit_StopAndLeave: 0x26 leaves to 0x25 (NOTE EDIT), otherwise to 0x28 (DRUM EDIT) -- 0x26 / 0x29 are their cycle-play screens

header:
When a progress value changed ((0x60FD42) bit 6, set by the progress recomputers) repaints the Sending screen if (0x60FD40) bit 6 is set, else the SYSTEM EXCLUSIVE PLEASE WAIT screen, then clears the changed bit.
The last step of SysExSession_StartProgressScreen and SysExSession_RefreshProgressScreen. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:99869 `calr sub_FB7E6C` -- SysExSession_StartProgressScreen, after the progress cells are set up
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:99914 `calr sub_FB7E6C` -- SysExSession_RefreshProgressScreen, after the five progress recomputers
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:99882 `m_set 6, MD24, 0x60fd42` -- sub_FB7B79 sets the changed bit only when the new value differs from (0x60F811)
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:100163 `m_bit 6, MD24, 0x60fd42` -- body: nothing changed -> return
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:100165 `m_bit 6, MD24, 0x60fd40` -- sending vs receiving selects the screen
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:100173 `call T_Paint_Sending_Entry` -- bit set: the Sending screen
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:100184 `call T_Paint_SystemExclusivePleaseWait_Entry` -- bit clear: SYSTEM EXCLUSIVE PLEASE WAIT
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:100190 `m_res 6, MD24, 0x60fd42` -- changed bit cleared after the repaint

why_refused: Its only caller is not SoundEditMenu_PaintPanAmountField but the unlabelled loop at 0xF09E52 in the dead bytes after that routine's ret, which nothing references; it is an older build's copy of SoundEditMenu_PaintPanAmountField whose call lands mid-instruction at 0xF09AB0, so it has no live role to name.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:18392 `call sub_F09E67` -- the only call site, inside the loop at 0xF09E52 (18388) that follows SoundEditMenu_PaintPanAmountField's ret (18361)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:18388 `ld (LCD_CurrentLayer:16), 0` -- 0xF09E52: no reference to this address in either image (command grep F09E52)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:18421 `call RunDisplayListBFromPointerArray - 0x31` -- the stale twin's call target 0xF09AB0 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:17911 `ld xiz, DigitalEffect_FieldRecordArrays` -- ... is the second byte of this instruction at 0xF09AAF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:18359 `call RunDisplayListBFromPointerArray` -- the live twin SoundEditMenu_PaintPanAmountField: same bytes, correct target

header:
Fills the chunk descriptor (arg 3, 0x0B83 from the caller: +0 kind 3, +1 start, +3 count clipped to the block and to 120, +5 block size, +7 index) for an offset in the drum image (region 0x060000):
the 135-byte common block below 152, the 128 two-byte entries at 152..407 (index (off-152)/2) or the 128 150-byte records from 408 (index (off-408)/150, sub_F36B94). Called by SysExThirdRegion_FetchNextChunk for drum offsets outside 82..151. Basis: caller + body + AcceptRequest header.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75575 `calr sub_F36CED` -- SysExThirdRegion_FetchNextChunk, drum offsets 152..407 -> then T_ToneMsg80_Id16 with the index (75580)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75590 `calr sub_F36CED` -- same caller, drum offsets < 82 or > 407 -> then T_F43488 (75595)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75536 `sub xbc, 393216` -- the caller's offset is relative to 0x060000
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75547 `calr sub_F36C5D` -- offsets 82..151 go to sub_F36C5D instead (75539-75542)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75570 `lda xbc, (2947:24)` -- the descriptor 0x0B83 is pushed first (arg +14); the caller then reads 0x0B84 / 0x0B86 / 0x0B8A
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75627 `0x060000+19608 (drum)` -- SysExThirdRegion_AcceptRequest header: region 0x060000 is the 19608-byte drum image; 408 + 128 x 150 = 19608
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75358 `cp xix, 408` -- body: offset >= 408 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75363 `pushw 150` -- ... index = (off - 408) / 150 (Divide32_Unsigned_Quotient 75365) -> +7 (75368)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75375 `calr sub_F36B94` -- ... and the record split
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75383 `m_ld_mi16 MDD+r1, 0x05, 0x0002` -- 152..407: block size 2, index (off-152)/2, kind 3 (75397)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75436 `m_ld_mi16 MDD+r1, 0x05, 0x0087` -- < 152: block size 0x87, index 0
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75458 `cp wa, 120` -- count capped at 120 bytes

header:
Consumes Seq_RequestRewind's (0x34D3) bit 0: dropped while transport A or B runs or tracks are record-armed; with a cycle on (sub_F448C6 = 0) the current measure goes to the cycle start ((0x3622) on the record screens 6/8, (0x361E) when past it),
otherwise Seq_RewindToStart and the per-track re-arm (sub_F44CA7). Called each pass by Seq_MainLoopService. Basis: caller + body + Seq_RequestRewind header.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93816 `calr sub_F44809` -- Seq_MainLoopService
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:95662 `sets (0x34D3) bit 0` -- Seq_RequestRewind's header: the sequencer tick (via sub_F44809) consumes it and moves to the cycle start or calls Seq_RewindToStart
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94100 `m_bit 0, MD16, 0x34d3` -- body: the request bit ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94102 `m_and_mi8 MB16, 0x34d3, 0xfe` -- ... taken and cleared
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94103 `bit 2, (TransportB_State:8)` -- dropped while B runs, while (0x3000) has armed tracks (94105) or A runs (94108)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94110 `calr sub_F448C6` -- A = 0 when a cycle is on for the current screen (94191-94212)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94126 `ld wa, (13858:16)` -- record screens: measure := (0x3622), the CYCLE RECORD start
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94117 `ld wa, (13854:16)` -- other screens: (0x361E), the CYCLE PLAY start, when the measure is past it
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94144 `calr Seq_RewindToStart` -- no cycle: rewind to the song start

why_refused: Its whole body is (0x34DA) := 0, and nothing in either image reads (0x34DA) (the only other access, in sub_F44D94, also stores 0), so neither the generic caller Seq_MainLoopService nor the body says what is being reset.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93819 `calr sub_F4495A` -- Seq_MainLoopService, one of its unnamed per-pass steps
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94298 `ld (13530:16), 0` -- the body: (0x34DA) := 0 between push/pop XIY
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94888 `ld (13530:16), 0` -- the only other access to (0x34DA), also a store of 0 (command grep 13530 / 0x34da)

header:
While nothing records ((0x3000) = 0): when a playing track still had data last pass ((0x300C) & (0x60341E)) and none has now ((0x3008) & (0x60341E); TimedEvents_ClearEndedTrackBits clears a track's bit at its end-of-chain tag), clears both masks and stops the transport;
unless a cycle is on and the measure is within its end ((0x3620), (0x3624) on the record screens) it also sets (0x34D4) bit 4 and queues timed events 0x88, 0x7F (sub_F44E58). Always ends (0x300C) := (0x3008). Called each pass by Seq_MainLoopService. Basis: caller + body + writer header.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93826 `calr sub_F44D94` -- Seq_MainLoopService
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94858 `ld xwa, (12288:16)` -- body: only when the record mask (0x3000) is empty
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94863 `ld xbc, (12300:16)` -- (0x300C) & playing mask (94864): tracks that had data last pass
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94865 `ld xde, (12296:16)` -- (0x3008) & playing mask (94866): tracks that still have data; acts only when the first is non-zero and this is zero (94867-94870)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:95899 `TimedEvents_ClearEndedTrackBits: Class-3 consumer` -- its header: clears bit n of (0x3008)/(0x300A) for each end-of-chain tag {0x82, n}
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94883 `call T_Transport_StopAllRunning` -- stops the transport (T_TransportB_Stop at 94886 when only A's bit 2 is set)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94889 `calr sub_F448C6` -- cycle-on test; with a cycle on, the measure is compared with (0x3620) (94897) or (0x3624) (94902)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94906 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x34d4, 0x10` -- end of song: (0x34D4) bit 4 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94913 `calr sub_F44E58` -- ... and timed events 0x88 / 0x7F (T_TimedEventRing_Put 94938, 94942)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94920 `ld (12300:16), xwa` -- (0x300C) := (0x3008) on every pass: the previous-pass snapshot

header:
Stops every transport (T_Transport_StopAllRunning), zeroes the track-data masks (0x3008)/(0x300C), discards the timed-event ring, posts the playback-stop request (0x34D2) bit 1 that Seq_StopPlaybackOnRequest consumes, and (0xA8) := 0.
The 'StopAll' of Seq_SaveTrackMaskAndStopAll (ModeEnter_Edit), also reached through the slots T_F40A7C, T_F409E8 and T_F40A20. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:95831 `calr sub_F455CC` -- Seq_SaveTrackMaskAndStopAll, after saving the playing mask in (0x3010)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:95824 `then sub_F455CC:` -- its header lists exactly this routine's effects
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:92939 `jrl sub_F455CC` -- sub_F4401E, slot T_F40A7C; also sub_F4545B (95714) and sub_F455C5 (96008)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96023 `call T_Transport_StopAllRunning` -- body
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96027 `calr TimedEventRing_Discard` -- pending timed events dropped
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96028 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x34d2, 0x02` -- request bit ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94960 `m_bit 1, MD16, 0x34d2` -- ... consumed by Seq_StopPlaybackOnRequest (note release, playing mask 0)

header:
GM mode ((0x7F4D) bit 2) only: BStore_TrackToPart[0..16] := WorkspaceDefaults+0x2D and workspace +0x33[0..16] := WorkspaceDefaults+0x3E, or +0x60 when (0x6034C7) bit 1. The non-GM twin sub_F45D80 (bit clear) uses +0x1C (BStore_TrackToPart_LoadDefaults) and sub_F442DA.
The first step of BStore_ResetWorkspaceToDefault ('track-to-part defaults by GM mode'). Basis: caller + body + twin.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93449 `calr sub_F45D80` -- the non-GM twin
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93441 `track-to-part defaults by GM mode` -- the caller's header
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:33016 `GM mode ((0x7F4D) bit 2)` -- ModeScreen_DrawGmModeGlyph: (0x7F4D) bit 2 is GM mode

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97137 `jr nz, sub_F45D80_Return` -- twin: runs only with GM mode clear ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97145 `calr BStore_TrackToPart_LoadDefaults` -- ... loading WorkspaceDefaults+0x1C

header:
The cycle screens' deferred-action timer: counts (0x3628) down while bit 7 is set and above 0x80 (sub_F45E5F); at 0x80 clears it and runs Dispatch_3629[(0x3629)] -- 0 relocate to the cycle start, 1 capture the end cursors, 2 both (sub_F45E76).
Run by EditScreen_Tick (slot T_F40A3C) after its own two timers; the CYCLE PLAY / CYCLE RECORD measure editors arm it 3 ticks ahead (0x83). Basis: caller + body + table + writers.
evidence: prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:177198 `call T_F40A3C` -- EditScreen_Tick, after EditScreen_CountDownAction / _RunDueAction / ...2 (177194-177197)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:89791 `T_F40A3C: jp sub_F45E58` -- slot T_F40A3C
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97306 `m_bit 7, MD16, 0x3628` -- sub_F45E5F: count down while armed ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97315 `decm8 1, (xix)` -- ... until 0x80 (97311)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97331 `m_cp_mi8 MBI+r4, 0, 0x80` -- sub_F45E76: due ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97414 `call T_SeqCycle_LocateToStart` -- arm [0] sub_F45EAF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97441 `call T_SeqCycle_CaptureEndCursors` -- arm [1] sub_F45ED2; arm [2] sub_F45EF2 calls both (97467-97468)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:121959 `ld (13864:16), 131` -- a writer: the CYCLE RECORD start-measure editor sub_F569AF arms 0x83 with action 2 (121960)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:121395 `ld (13864:16), 0` -- ScreenLeave_CycleRecordScreen disarms it (also ScreenLeave_CyclePlayScreen / _CyclePlayEditScreen)
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:178921 `m_bit 7, MD24, EditScreen_ActionTimer` -- the prom_a twin EditScreen_CountDownAction / EditScreen_RunDueAction: the same countdown-and-dispatch shape

header:

Called each pass by Seq_MainLoopService. Basis: caller + body + producers.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93821 `calr sub_F45FCA` -- Seq_MainLoopService
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97615 `m_bit 5, MD16, 0x34d1` -- body: request bit ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97617 `m_and_mi8 MB16, 0x34d1, 0xdf` -- ... taken and cleared
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97618 `ld (UI_StatusCode:16), 15` -- status 0x0F
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97619 `ld (UI_Request:16), 171` -- message 0xAB with UI_Request_Hi |= 0x40 (97620): 0x40AB
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97601 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x34d1, 0x20` -- Var34D1_SetBits20, the producer
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:178164 `sets (0x34D1) bits 5+4` -- EditScreen_FlagMemoryFull's header: prom_b sub_F45FCA then shows status 0x0F / request 0x40AB

notes/FINDINGS-prom_b-song-store.md:141 `(0x2880) = 0x0F` -- BStore_AppendBytes' allocation failure writes the same status / message (0x40AB)

header:
Copies the 17 live track cursors -- block words 0x3460[] and offsets 0x3482[] -- to 0x3692[] / 0x36B4[]; sub_F486BA copies them back.
First step of SeqCycle_CaptureEndCursors ('saves the live track cursors'), also slot T_F40B68 for the cycle-record code. Basis: caller header + body + inverse twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99749 `calr sub_F4869B` -- SeqCycle_CaptureEndCursors' first instruction
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99744 `Saves the live track cursors` -- SeqCycle_CaptureEndCursors' header
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99935 `All 17 track cursors := block word 1 (0x3460[]) and offset 5 (0x3482[])` -- SeqTrackCursors_ResetAll: 0x3460/0x3482 are the 17 track cursors
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99894 `ld xde, 13970` -- body: destination 0x3692, source 0x3460 (99895), 17 words (99893, ldirw 99896)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99898 `ld xde, 14004` -- destination 0x36B4, source 0x3482 (99899), 17 bytes
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99916 `ld xde, 13408` -- sub_F486BA: the same two copies in the other direction (restore)

header:
A := 0 when tracks are record-armed ((0x3000) != 0), the screen latch is a CYCLE RECORD screen (6 or 8), the track in (0x349F) is the cycle record track (0x36D6) and the CYCLE switch ((0x360B) bit 1) is on; otherwise A := 0xFF. Preserves XBC.
SeqCycle_LocateToStart and the cycle deferred actions call it (slot T_F40BE4) with (0x349F) := (0x36D6) and branch on A == 0. Basis: callers + body + CycleRecord_CheckOn / SetUpRecordTrack headers.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99654 `call T_F40BE4` -- SeqCycle_LocateToStart, with (0x349F) := (0x36D6) (99652-99653), then `cp a,0` (99655)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97411 `call T_F40BE4` -- the deferred action sub_F45EAF: same set-up and test
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:89881 `T_F40BE4: jp sub_F49A3D` -- slot T_F40BE4
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:101435 `ld xbc, (12288:16)` -- body: record mask empty -> 0xFF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:101438 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenLatch, 0x06` -- screen latch 6 or 8 (101440), else 0xFF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:101444 `m_cp_rm MB16, 0x36d6, 2` -- track (0x349F) must be (0x36D6)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:101446 `m_bit 1, MD16, 0x360b` -- CYCLE switch on -> return with A = 0; otherwise A := 0xFF (101449)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108683 `CycleRecord_CheckOn: A := 0 when the screen latch is a CYCLE RECORD screen` -- the sibling test without the track condition
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:102923 `the` -- CycleRecord_SetUpRecordTrack: the lowest armed track becomes (0x36D6) (102924)

header:

Run when LcdKeyRow2_RealtimeRecordScreen switches CYCLE record off and before each cycle-record set-up (sub_F4A5B5). Basis: callers + body + SeqRecord_SaveCursorBaseline header.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:120868 `call T_F40BF8` -- LcdKeyRow2_RealtimeRecordScreen, on the CYCLE-off branch (120862 `res 1,(0x360b)`), after T_F40BF4 = sub_F4A6CF (120867)

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:102881 `0x36FA/0x36FC to 0xFFFF without freeing them` -- SeqRecord_SaveCursorBaseline's header: 0x36FA/0x36FC are the take-chain heads

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:103117 `ld iy, (14076:16)` -- body: head; 0xFFFF -> nothing (103118)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:103120 `ldw (14076:16), 65535` -- head cleared ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:103122 `call T_F40C94` -- ... and the chain freed with WA = 0xFFFF (103121)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107111 `jrl sub_F4D89D` -- T_F40C94's target sub_F4D026 jumps to the free-chain routine
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:103094 `ld iy, (14074:16)` -- sub_F4A6CF: the same for (0x36FA)

header:
